readout_before_results.controls: TRAIN identity and nearclean source/profile strata remain visible; identity AUC is null because all labels are negative. Report its falseK1/coverage instead.
readout_before_results.information_with_positive_offset: If old score AUROC is consistently above.5 across sources despite BA=.5, its ranking contains sign information not expressed by its fixedzero decisions. This does not authorize a threshold shift.
readout_before_results.weighting_sensitive: If weights-only fit improves source balanced accuracy while reducing negativefalseK1 and retaining positive recall, class weighting affects extractable decisions in this linear family. Report the full tradeoff rather than just an all-raw constant.
readout_before_results.negative_or_heterogeneous: No consistent source-level advantage, only an all-raw/all-K1 action, or lost positive recall: pause this head branch. Do not respond by increasing steps, changingridge, tryingnewthresholds or reopening6DEV.
readout_before_results.positive_result_limit: Even a descriptive positive result does not restore the failedDEV gate or prove physicalMAE/LPIPS/deployment benefit. It only motivates a future separately designed objective/data experiment after the stated pause.
